description: Real data, nothing made up: the first live reading the memory step published, built on the five readings before it, as the workflow published it on observatory-data at commit 7a2c8a3. The RPC refused its socket on that run, so the reading holds no head. tape.jsonl, snapshot.json, run.json and SHA256SUMS are latest/ at that commit, byte for byte; log/2026-11-11.jsonl is the day file of the log at that commit, its six lines, this reading's the last. SHA256SUMS lists all nine published files; only these four are kept here.
